SHIPPING_FEE = 499                # cents ($4.99)
MEMBER_DISCOUNT = 10              # percent
MAX_DISCOUNT = 30                 # percent


def checkout(subtotal: int, coupon: int, member: bool) -> tuple[int, int]:

    price    = subtotal minus member and coupon discounts (stacked, capped
               at 30%), rounded to the nearest cent (halves round up).

               price + shipping never exceeds $50.00 (this keeps the
